data.narrative:
Stacked Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Dylan Erb and Sumitha Durairaj that has raised $98M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 8 private peers in Climate & Energy (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix) and 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Valuation was approached using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation method given data constraints. This approach applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression to the $98M total raised as a proxy base, yielding an implied valuation of $196M. A peer-median approach was not feasible; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the narrow filter criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) necessary for statistically defensible multiples—a minimum of 3 filtered comparables is required.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $167M (low) to $225M (high), with a median point of $196M. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression derived midpoint. Key uncertainties include the lack of directly comparable same-stage transaction data in the climate tech subsector and the reliance on a single methodological pillar. Until adjacent-stage or follow-on financing activity provides transaction evidence, this range should be treated as preliminary and revisited as market data accumulates.
